purpose: Observe one bound parameter0 3x3 stem weight coordinate in a new zero-update call using independently restored training-failure state; separate selected local numerical components without replay or model changes.

target.identityRule: jointly verify index/name/parameter graph/module type/source SHA/weight bytes and before-after versions; shape alone is insufficient
target.historicalVersionRule: Record actual fresh-instance versions; do not fabricate them to match archived counters
target.convolutionConfiguration: Bind exact torch.nn.Conv2d at canonical index0/name/module; batch1,input[1,31,192,256],output[1,48,192,256],kernel3x3/stride1/pad1/dilation1/groups1/zeros; retain selected input13/output1 planes and five original full target gradients. Preserve all existing model arithmetic.

definitions.A: The selected coordinate of observed native actualTotal target gradient, cast to FP64 only for arithmetic
definitions.Bi: The selected coordinate of each of four native component target gradients cast to FP64
definitions.E: The selected coordinate of the original ordered FP32 sum of four native component gradients, then cast to FP64
definitions.T: CPU FP64 products with stable summation at [1,13,0,0] using input13 and actualTotal output1-adjoint planes, applying original 3x3 zero-padding index offsets
definitions.Si: Four CPU FP64 selected-coordinate references using the respective component adjoint planes
definitions.S: FP64 stable sum of the four Si
definitions.B: FP64 stable sum of the four saved native FP32 component values at this selected coordinate

comparison.interpretation: Only the one selected coordinate in this new observation is covered. T-S observes selected upstream contribution; A-T and B-S compare native gradients to finite-precision local references; B-E is final component-sum rounding. The observational decomposition is not a proof of implementation error, necessary FP64 repair, complete-model cause or historical replay. Hooks and synchronization may perturb timing. No threshold changes.
comparison.upstreamRule: Retain exact original FP32 input13 and output1-adjoint planes, check identity/finiteness and count; record plane hashes and signed contractions. This is an input projection, not proof of upstream elementwise equality. Other channels and coordinates are outside this diagnosis.

cpuPreparation.scope: bound archive/state/sample identity, synthetic observer and exact request ABI; no real forward

stopRules: Only an authentic unchanged full108 original gate failure at target0 and the bound [1,13,0,0] coordinate over original tolerance with five complete same-call captures permits local references after first-error preservation
No optimizer, D gradient/update, model modification, train restart, Checkpoint selection/save or image output
No validation/challenge/regression asset content, extra sample, extra layer or extra coordinate
Gate pass, other gate position, selected coordinate not reproduced, mutation or incomplete evidence closes the one attempt without local reference or retry
Cleanup must derive from this invocation's live native proof, not historical files or vanished PID
acceptance: Exact current policy, formal version, original source graph, interpreter, failed state and sample plus own CPU synthetic behaviour match
One original G forward and five G gradient groups; no D gradient, optimizer or updates
Actual original torch.nn.Conv2d type/source/geometry, original selected coordinate, independent copies, versions/modes/sample/RNG verified; no historical replay claim
First original gate error and selected FP32 evidence committed before bounded CPU reference
Real total timing, bytes, stream and managed cleanup accounted; completion/not-reproduced/failure closes the attempt

The exact canonical metadata program and original Node interpreter are bound in the request and restricted reader; own CPU suite reaches the real derive_regime_record/bound_regime snapshot path without mocking that dependency.

localContrastPermittedOnlyIf: All five original G gradients complete in the original order
Unchanged actual gate source, function code, traceback and parameter0 locals match these same-call target gradients
The bound [1,13,0,0] coordinate exceeds the unchanged original absolute/relative tolerance
All selected input/adjoint planes and target native gradients finite, exact identity and copies preserved
Original first error and target capture persisted before any local reference; state unchanged and resources remain
gateFailureContinuation.whenExactTargetFailure: Preserve original error and same-call capture before local math; never return reference gradients to training
gateFailureContinuation.whenOtherFailure: diagnostic_failed_closed, or diagnostic_not_reproduced for selected-coordinate non-reproduction; neither performs local reference

captureBudget.rule: Enforce actual aggregate target archive/metadata/error/reference plus temporaries and terminal reserve <=2MiB; observation/copy/reference working tensors <=64MiB. All GPU-phase output including host, native builds, registry, streams, temporary bytes and closure <=128MiB; CPU preparation <=8MiB. Estimates do not grant admission. Original archive is input only and never copied to output.

captureRestrictions.upstreamDifference: Only channel13 input and channel1 output-adjoint planes for bound [1,13,0,0]; no second full activation or global-gradient capture persisted. Fixed coordinate is not dynamically replaced.

accounting: Phase budgets include startup, restore, math, native supervision, closure, source/build copies, logs, stream output and receipts. Safe decoder separately bounds compressed bytes, decompressed archive and decoded tensors. Release archive and decoded objects before observation; 64MiB target observation workspace is not a whole-process CPU RSS claim.
sourceGraphRule: Collect actual original and new diagnostic program closure with paths and recomputed SHA, at most256 entries; authenticate loaded modules and exact current CPU evidence. Prior parameter60 or saved-gradient CPU success grants no admission.
